INCORPORATED 1939

  ACTION MINUTES
  OF THE MAY 12, 2020 SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

A Special teleconference meeting of the Palos Verdes Estates City council via Zoom pursuant to
Executive Order N25-20 issued by Governor Gavin ewsom on March 12, 2020, was called to
order by Mayor McGowan at 4:03 pm, notice having been given with affidavit thereto on file.
Members of the public were provided with the following information to provide public input:
Join Zoom Meeting:

https://us02web.zoom .us/j/85096617075
Meeting ID : 850 9661 7075

Or via phone (669) 900-9128 Code: 85096627075#

NEXT RESOLUTION NO. R20-13

NEXT ORDINANCE NO. 020-745

PRESENT:  Mayor McGowan, Mayor Pro Tern Kemps, Councilmembers Davidson,
  Kao and Lozzi

ABSENT  None

ALSO PRESENT:  Acting City Manager Rukavina, City Attorney Hogin, Assistant to the City
  Manager Banales, Treasurer Ying, City Clerk Chaney

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

ACTION: Moved by Councilmember Kao, Seconded by Mayor Pro Tern Kemps to approve
the Agenda

Motion Carried by the following Roll Call Vote :
Aye: Lozzi, Kao , Davidson, Kemps, McGowan
No : none

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC - None

NEW BUSINESS

  1.  City Council Workshop

  A. Review necessity for ad hoc and standing committees - review of purpose and
  scope

  Desiree Myers addressed the City Council

  The City Council discussed the Investment Policy Advisory Committee, and the
  possible addition of new members.

  Acting City Manager Rukavina noted that the City would need to update the Municipal

City Council Special Meeting Minutes
May 26, 2020  1
   Code in order to add additional Committee members.

  ACTION: Moved by Mayor Pro Tern Kemps, Seconded by Councilmember Kao to
  add two new members to the Investment Policy Advisory Committee
  Motion Carried by the following Roll Call Vote :
  Aye : Lozzi, Kao, Davidson, Kemps, McGowan
  No: none

  The City Council discussed no change to the Planning Commission or Parklands
  Committee.

  There was a discussion regarding the Traffic Safety Committee, it was noted that there
  would be no change to the committee.

  The City Council discussed the Finance Advisory Committee, and decided no change
  to the committee.

  The City Council discussed the Technology Advisory Committee and the
  Environmental Committee and it was decided that these Committees would be placed
  on hold for a period of six months at which time the Council will reevaluate.

  B. Discuss issues surrounding a transactions and use tax and certificates of
  participation

  Jim Priest, BB&K and Andy Nickerson, HDL presented to the City Council regarding
  Transactions and Use Tax. There was discussion regarding the forecast for revenue
  presented in a previous report for leased and purchased vehicles, and the relation to the
  population. There was also discussion regarding the City versus the County in the
  addition to a Transactions and Use Tax to the November Ballot. City Attorney Hogin
  noted that the Council would want to hold a Public Meeting if the Council was
  considering adding a measure to the Ballot.

  The Council provided their views and asked clarifying questions about potential Los
  Angeles County tax initiatives, Internet Sales Tax and future tax initiatives for Palos
  Verdes Estates. Jim Priest and Andy Nickerson provided clarification.
  Staff was directed to retain a proposal from HDL for the analysis and forecast of a
  potential measure for Transactions and Use Tax.

  There being no further business to come before the City Council, Mayor McGowan adjourned the
  meeting at 6: 15 pm.

  Respectfully submitted:

  \Q~

  APPROVED:

  David A. McGowan, Mayor
